visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a giant, furry Catbus prop featuring glowing yellow eyes and a broad, smiling mouth. A young man in a beanie and grey jacket is seen waving from a circular cutout on the side. The scene transitions to an outdoor courtyard at Huashan 1914 where a large white billboard promotes the Animage and Ghibli exhibition with colorful illustrations. (2) The interior of the exhibition is shown, featuring expansive walls covered in historic anime magazine covers and giant posters from series like Gundam and Laputa. The man walks through the gallery wearing oversized headphones for an audio guide, looking closely at rows of magazines protected by plastic. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional museum space. (3) Detailed close-ups highlight various exhibition artifacts, including original production sketches, hand-drawn manga panels from Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind, and life-sized statues of iconic characters. The man poses in several interactive photo zones, such as standing behind a giant magazine-cover frame and sitting on a bench next to a large Totoro figure under hanging playing cards. (4) The final segment focuses on the merchandise shop, where shelves are packed with Ghibli-themed plush toys, stationery, and decorative plates. A hand is shown interacting with a No-Face piggy bank. The atmosphere is vibrant and commercial, with multiple visitors visible in the background browsing the goods under warm indoor lighting.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for the 'Animage and Ghibli Exhibition' held at Huashan 1914 Creative Park. By showcasing the extensive collection of historic magazines, production manuscripts, and life-sized character models, it aims to attract anime fans and tourists. The creator uses interactive photo spots and the merchandise shop to highlight the exhibition's experiential appeal.
